## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.11 — screen sync on Android, and a usable mobile UI

> **Alpha.** Everything Android below is built but has never run on a phone.
> If something misbehaves: **Settings → Diagnostics → Download** and send the
> file.

### Screen sync now works on Android

The Sync tab was missing because the phone defaulted to a lights-only profile
— deliberate while there was no way to capture, since a tab that cannot sync
is worse than no tab.

No mobile browser implements `getDisplayMedia`, so this had to be native. The
app now holds a `MediaProjection`, mirrors the display at 320×180 and feeds
the colour pipeline directly — frames never pass through JavaScript, so a 30
fps stream costs a function call rather than megabytes a second through a
WebView bridge.

Expect Android's screen-capture consent dialog on first start, and an ongoing
notification while syncing (the system requires both). There is no live video
preview on the phone: the frames bypass the page, so the canvas would be
permanently black. The zone colour swatches still work.

### Mobile UI fixes

All four from real use:

- **The header was drawn behind the status bar** — under the clock and
  notification icons, and unclickable because the system consumed the touches.
  `targetSdk 35` makes Android 15+ draw edge-to-edge. The worst part was that
  the obscured link was Settings, so the app could not be debugged from
  itself.
- **Navigation moved to a floating bottom bar** on phones. The top of a screen
  is the hardest place to reach one-handed and the easiest to lose to a status
  bar or camera cutout.
- **The pairing panel had no side margins** and ran flush against both edges.
- **Card titles were clipped mid-word** with no ellipsis — `text-overflow`
  was set on a flex container, where it does nothing.

### Known issues

Bridge discovery remains the most likely Android failure: the OS drops
multicast by default and some ROMs filter it regardless of the lock the app
takes. Manual IP entry is on the pairing screen and works.

See [KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
